Description:
[list]
[*][size=3]﻿Adds shirts/pants/skirts/jackets for male and female![/size]
[*][size=3]These can be selected with the [u]hand mirror[/u] from the fashion sense mod, this is bought from Pierres. [img]https://i.imgur.com/dRt6lC5.png[/img]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion sense[/url][u]﻿[/u] must be installed as this is a pack for the mod[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8138][/url][url=http://][/url]Some hairs﻿﻿ in screenshots are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8138]here[/url]﻿, {male hairs are from a separate discontinued mod}, accessories from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10659]here[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][center]
   To install this mod simply place and extract into the mods folder[/center]

[center][size=3]Items such as accessory jackets and custom pants aren't perfect as FS doesn't support all of the ingame animations but I have added all the ones possible. When carrying items and running jackets will sometimes flash the wrong frame and actions such as emotes and flower dance are unsupported as it isn't possible with FS atm.[/size]

[size=4]Please note that some items were made with [/size][b]GH's body mod[/b][size=4] in mind, but it[/size][b] isn't a requirement!
[/b][size=2]If there's anything considerably wrong with items on vanilla bodies let me know and I'll make a separate version <3[/size]
